title: Ember and Veil
author: W. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Jonah Joubert, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
